title: Landing-zone onboarding stages
method: Synthetic accepted-request workflow with sequential stage times totaling ten hours. Reducing network setup from four to one changes the modeled total to seven. Real lead time includes waiting, rework and incomplete requests.
alt: Landing-zone onboarding stages: Identity assignment 2 elapsed hours, Network and DNS 4 elapsed hours, Logging and ownership 1 elapsed hours, First deployment 3 elapsed hours. Illustrative inputs.
